question: Locate the hinted-only ARM C1 residual: old lane snapshot ordering, primary probe stores before hints, or register-carried Ring frontier.

factors.name: lane
factors.preparation: In-place; zero-emission register barrier snapshots old lane before publishing new lane stores

factors.name: storefirst
factors.preparation: In-place; primary probe assignments precede identical hint emission

factors.name: frontier
factors.preparation: In-place; register-carried Ring frontier Cursor; stored job arguments retained

measurement_limits: Initial three-repetition diagnostic; not the final seven-repetition panel
One immutable map per executable invocation; repeated operation preparation and all timed stage visits remain charged
Factor order alternates across different cases; a second optional pass reverses within each same case
Logical visits and potential hint targets are not PMU stalls, IPC or measured memory traffic
Original row-key layout; current owning-thread wider-value and key-layout changes excluded
All four factors retain original key/hash/data probe order, job footprint, data, hint windows and operation stages. Frontier Cursor remains a private diagnostic, not a public ABI.

prior_diagnostic.result: Primary-only preparation closes unhinted C1 gap while approximately35ns hinted gap persists.
